Pricing plans — Higgsfield AI Video & Image Generator

name: Higgsfield AI
summary: Multi-model AI platform for generating and editing video, image and voice content for creators, ads and film.
description: Higgsfield is an AI-native creative suite: multi-model video generation (Sora, Kling, Veo, WAN, Seedance), image generation (Nano Banana, FLUX, GPT Image, Seedream, Soul), one-click visual effects, Cinema Studio, storyboard and lipsync tools, plus an MCP server, an API and an After Effects plugin. A Creator Hub hosts guides, changelog, help center and Academy.
contains: 94 public creative apps and 22 app collections
multi-model video: Sora, Kling, Veo, WAN, Seedance and more
multi-model image: Nano Banana, FLUX, GPT Image, Seedream, Soul and more
Cinema Studio, Storyboard Generator, Lipsync Studio, AI Influencer Studio, Moodboard, Upscale
MCP server for Claude and ChatGPT, API, After Effects plugin
free tier with a small set of models and no credits; paid individual, team and enterprise plans with monthly credits
25M+ users, 850M+ generations, ~6M generations and ~2M videos per day
